gaps.requirement: Establish and implement a due diligence policy identifying human rights and environmental risks in operations and supply chain.
gaps.factory_status: MISSING — no documented due diligence policy exists
gaps.recommendation: Draft board-level supply chain due diligence policy covering all tier-1 suppliers before CSDDD Phase 1 deadline.

gaps.requirement: Working hours must not exceed 48 regular hours per week. Overtime must not exceed 12 hours per week and must be voluntary.
gaps.display_title: Cap Working Hours to SA8000 Limit
gaps.factory_status: NON_CONFORMANT — audit records show average 62 hrs/week during peak season, overtime not documented as voluntary
gaps.recommendation: Implement hour-tracking system, cap at 48+12, obtain written voluntary overtime consent from all workers.

gaps.requirement: Publish annual Modern Slavery and Human Trafficking Statement approved by board, signed by director, linked from homepage.
gaps.factory_status: MISSING — no statement published for FY2025
gaps.recommendation: Draft s.54 statement covering 6 required areas, get board approval, publish on company website.

gaps.requirement: Azo dyes that can release carcinogenic aromatic amines are prohibited in textile articles. Formaldehyde must not exceed 75 ppm for infants, 300 ppm for skin-contact garments.
gaps.factory_status: UNVERIFIED — no third-party chemical testing certificate on file. Factory uses reactive dyes from 3 unverified suppliers.
gaps.recommendation: Commission Oeko-Tex or SGS chemical compliance test for all dye lots from current suppliers.

contradictions.claim: Factory self-reports SA8000 certification as current and valid
contradictions.evidence: SA8000 certificate shows expiry date 12 Jan 2026 — expired. Payroll records also show 62-hr work weeks violating SA8000 working hours requirement.
contradictions.source_b: fwi_fsd_001.pdf — SA8000 certificate scan + payroll records
contradictions.impact: An expired SA8000 certificate paired with 62-hour weeks means buyers relying on the self-report face an unmanaged labour-compliance risk.

action_chain.title: Establish CSDDD Supply Chain Due Diligence Policy
action_chain.description: Draft and board-approve a supply chain due diligence policy covering all tier-1 suppliers before the CSDDD Phase 1 deadline.

action_chain.title: Cap working hours + document voluntary overtime consent
action_chain.description: Cap regular hours at 48, limit overtime to 12 hrs/week, and obtain written voluntary overtime consent from all workers.

action_chain.title: Publish UK Modern Slavery Act s.54 Statement
action_chain.description: Draft the s.54 statement covering the 6 required areas, obtain board approval, and publish it on the company website with a homepage link.

action_chain.title: Commission REACH / Oeko-Tex Chemical Compliance Test
action_chain.description: Commission an Oeko-Tex or SGS chemical compliance test for all dye lots from current suppliers to verify azo-dye and formaldehyde limits.

notes: Faisal Weave Industries is the flagship CRITICAL demo factory: expired SA8000, 62-hr weeks, no CSDDD policy, unpublished MSA statement, and unverified REACH chemical status. Score and PKR are pinned via demo_report override.
